verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm and states it provides 'end-to-end immigration support, guiding clients through every step of a given process,' including processing visas for start-ups and key employees. That is a first-party claim of full-service petition handling, but none of the specific deliverables are documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence-binder preparation, expert/support letter drafting, form preparation and filing as named service components, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: We provide end-to-end immigration support, guiding clients through every step of a given process.
processing visas for key employees, Green and Spiegel U.S. is the perfect firm
Green & Spiegel can assist you with any type of immigration application in Canada or the United States.
